title: Paying Attention to Deflections: Mining Pragmatic Nuances for Whataboutism Detection in Online Discourse
reasoning: The paper focuses on the pragmatic detection of whataboutism, a rhetorical strategy for deflecting criticism. While its datasets include discussions on sociopolitical, religious, and ethical topics (such as abortion, religious freedom, and war crimes), the research does not evaluate religious beliefs, moral frameworks, or ethical reasoning as its primary subject, focusing instead on linguistic patterns and propaganda detection.
